verdict.rationale: Insomnia ships the first-party Inso CLI, which is explicitly designed to run in CI. It disables prompts and returns pass/fail exit codes, and it can automate API test runs and lint OpenAPI specs to fail builds. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of headless CI use, and detailed documentation of the full CLI command surface (e.g., collection runs, environment selection) beyond tests and linting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Inso CLI is designed to run in a Continuous Integration (CI) environment. It disables prompts and provides exit codes to pass or fail the CI workflow.
Use the Insomnia CLI to automate the execution of your API tests using your existing Git workflows.
In CI, use inso lint spec <identifier> to lint OpenAPI and fail builds on errors.
